doc.title: Carol Bash interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2012

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe hopes she returns to present the finished film; they exchange thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well it’s been such a pleasure to have you here and I know that we got some nice response. I have a feeling that you’ll be back, and not just to visit but to present —
The final project. The real film. I would love to. I would love to. Thank you, Monk. That’s a great name.
Best of luck, and thank you for what you’re doing. We need you and creative people out there taking on these kind of projects.
Alright. Best wishes. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -13-
